test_title: PYST 06: SSC JE CE - General Intelligence (Held on 07 Jun 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

'A + B' means 'A is the mother of B',

'A - B' means 'A is the brother of B',

'A × B' means 'A is the sister of B', and

'A ÷ B' means 'A is the husband of B'.

How is L related to R if 'N - S ÷ L × M + Q - R'?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Mother
 Brother
 Sister
 Husband
 
 

 

Given: N - S ÷ L × M + Q - R

Let's decode step by step:

 
• N - S: N is the brother of S.
 
• S ÷ L: S is the husband of L.
 
• L × M: L is the sister of M.
 
• M + Q: M is the mother of Q.
 
• Q - R: Q is the brother of R.

Combining these relationships:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ad399c3cc8c18adf9c9d4e592d0c68ee87a164ec587c58e0b603723e7136b86.png] 

So, L is the mother's sister of R.

Hence, the correct answer is** option 4.**
